description: All user profiles are stored under one shared cache key.

candidates.title: Every user profile overwrites the same cache entry

evidence.execution_path: CacheProfile receives userID but omits it from the key, so a second user's write replaces the first user's entry
evidence.violated_invariant: Cached per-user data must be keyed by the user identity or another equally isolating namespace
evidence.falsifier_checked: The complete function does not namespace the key and the Cache interface receives only the constant key and value

candidates.impact: Reads through the shared key can return another user's profile or stale data.
candidates.recommendation: Include the stable user identifier and schema namespace in the cache key.

verdicts.reason: The user-specific input is demonstrably absent from the only cache key written by the function.
